arithmetic: Annual KAF = sum(daily cfs) x 1.9835/1000. CV = sd/mean of three-gauge water-year totals. Strike Team quotes 2021-22 <1,000 KAF and 2023-24 >2,000 KAF: a 2x swing in consecutive years, inconsistent with CV 0.35.
notes: Gauge sum is lower than Strike Team totals (e.g. 2025: 1,108 vs 1,281 KAF; ungauged/other inflow not included) but the CV is scale-free. Every period gives CV 0.50-0.60; 0.35 understates variability. Model draws normal anomalies floored at 0.2, so CV 0.5 is near the limit of the Gaussian form; a lognormal draw would fit better. Note Strike Team itself resamples 2000-2025 years rather than using a parametric CV.

extra_sources.title: Great Salt Lake Data and Insights Summary
extra_sources.quote: depletions from the three mineral companies declined from 186 KAF in 2020 to 77 KAF in 2024.

arithmetic: Model: 2,387 - 1,584 - 475 (residential: 409 outdoor + 66 indoor) = 328, which implicitly puts the 27 KAF reservoir evaporation into this category and uses an indoor figure (66) not found in any source. From the source: residential 2024 = 408.5/0.969 = 421.6 KAF (indoor ~13.1). Non-residential M&I = 640 - 421.6 = 218.4; + minerals 136 = 354.4 KAF/yr. Cross-check with the 61% share: 640 x 0.39 = 249.6 + 136 = 385.6.
notes: 328 is not stated anywhere; it is a residual. Two problems: (1) reservoir evaporation (27 KAF, 2020-24) is folded in, contradicting charge_base's own definition; (2) residential indoor 66 KAF is ~5x the Strike Team's implied 2024 indoor (3.1% of residential, ~13 KAF). Corrected value ~354 mixes 2024 residential with 2020-24 averages (DWR's 2020-24 residential average not published in the text; the figure 14 series is not extractable). Range 320-390 covers the year-mixing. Also CONSUMERS in data.ts lists minerals 152 (2025-report value for 1999-2003) vs 136 in the current 2020-24 table. Minerals are falling fast (77 KAF from three companies in 2024).

arithmetic: By the model's own definition (all depletion except residential and reservoir evaporation): 2,387 - 27 (reservoir) - 421.6 (residential 2024) = 1,938.4. Equivalently ag 1,584 + corrected mi 354.4 = 1,938.4. Model's 1,584 + 328 = 1,912 is arithmetically consistent with its inputs but its inputs subtract 475 residential and 0 reservoir.
